name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | OG Kush + Rainbow Z
description:
Classic meets modern with this balanced pairing. Earthy, piney OG Kush contrasts perfectly with the vibrant candy-fruit profile of Rainbow Z for a flavorful mix of old-school and new-school vibes.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
